name: join-four-table-chain
description: Benchmark four-table chained joins and cross references to earlier aliases

queries.name: four-inner
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier, b.country, c.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id JOIN accounts b ON a.user_id = b.user_id JOIN accounts c ON b.user_id = c.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: four-left
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier, b.country, c.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN accounts b ON a.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN accounts c ON b.user_id = c.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: four-cross-reference
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier, b.country, c.country FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id JOIN accounts b ON b.user_id = e.user_id JOIN accounts c ON c.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20
